message.content:
**Allele Frequency of rs7412 (APOE ε2) in Europeans**

| Population | Allele Frequency (C allele) |
|------------|-----------------------------|
| European (EUR) | **~0.13–0.15** |

*Sources:*  
- 1000 Genomes Project Phase 3 – European (EUR) dataset.  
- ExAC/gnomAD v2.1.1 – European ancestry subset.  

These values represent the proportion of chromosomes carrying the C allele at rs7412 among individuals of European descent.
